messages.subject: Error T5A5 Error Processing Accelerometer Data using GGIR
parts:
We are currently running into an error when we get to Part 5 (printing the report). We are reading in 7 .csv files for a participant (triaxial data from TicWatch). The GGIR program is loading the files in Part 1 without a problem (no errors showing up), but when we get to printing the report in Part 5 we a T5A5 Error

I have attached the R Code and a copy of the Screen Output received.

I would appreciate your advice on how to address this error.

Kathryn Fisher, PhD
McMaster University

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error T5A5 Error Processing Accelerometer Data using GGIR
parts:
This is the same error as discussed in https://groups.google.com/g/RpackageGGIR/c/H2E-3qXen4Y/m/RpToXSY-AAAJ, which I fixed and will soon be available on GitHub and then in the next release. However, as I clarified in the message there is enough valid data in the recording which makes that there is no output and that then causes the error. The fix avoids the error message but that does not address the fact that there is no valid output.

Next time please search the google group's history for previous discussions of the same error then I do not have to do that for you.

Thanks,

Vincent
